x-openregister._note: Generic audit statement (ADR-037 additive pattern; OpenSpec change generic-audit-statement). Declares AuditStatement and supersedes KascommissieVerklaring NON-DESTRUCTIVELY (active:false, definition and rows kept), the same supersession unified-decision-templates and generic-body-configuration used. MigrateKascommissieToAuditStatement copies the rows. The record was ALREADY generic in shape — a financial year, a verdict, a body — so only the name changes; the assoc-mode visibility gate stays, because organisatie_modus is the app's own mechanism for adapting vocabulary per organisation type and the Dutch label now lives in MODE_LABELS rather than in the schema name.

AuditStatement.title: AuditStatement
AuditStatement.description: An audit committee's statement on a body's accounts for one financial year. Generalises KascommissieVerklaring, which named the same record in VvE terms only. A kascommissie is one kind of audit committee; a provincial auditcommissie and a company's audit committee produce the same record, and the seeded bodies already include an Auditcommissie Provincie Noord-Holland that had no way to file one.

financialYear.title: Financial year
financialYear.description: The financial year this statement covers.

verdict.title: Verdict
verdict.description: The committee’s conclusion on the accounts for that year.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Any qualification or remark the committee recorded.

agendaItem.title: Agenda item
agendaItem.description: The agenda item where the accounts were adopted.

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: The body whose accounts were examined.

_designNote.financialYear: The financial year (boekjaar) the verklaring covers. Required.
_designNote.verdict: The kascommissie's verdict on the administration. Required.
_designNote.notes: Free-text explanation of the verdict (e.g. the voorbehoud). Optional.
_designNote.agendaItem: Reference to the jaarrekening AgendaItem of the ALV this verklaring is linked to. Optional (a verklaring may be recorded before the agenda exists).
_designNote.governanceBody: Reference to the GovernanceBody (the VvE) this verklaring belongs to. Required.

KascommissieVerklaring.description: SUPERSEDED (generic-audit-statement): the same record is declared on AuditStatement (slug audit-statement) in terms that fit any audit committee. Definition and slug are kept, not deleted (hardDelete:false, existing rows), so a rollback still finds its data.
